summary: Lee County Schools urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding at current levels, maintain the existing discount matrix, preserve Pre‑K eligibility, and allow local control over CIPA and screen‑time policies. LCS urges the FCC to keep the current E‑Rate framework, including its discount structure and safety requirements, so that students remain eligible and districts are not burdened with new costs.
